I shipped two of the five menu fixes, so the task is partial. The map is written. Of the three problems I left, two are his wording and ordering and need his answer. The third, a non-setting in the Settings Rec tab, I didn't get to. Both shipped fixes passed preflight and the gate, and the seed 4242 fingerprint (ents 85/374, containers 165/593) didn't move.

**Shipped (both on the title screen):**
- **v29.30, key line:** it said "H controls", but H has healed since the key swap and F1 opens the controls list. A guest who read the title and pressed H healed instead. It now says "F1 controls".
- **v29.32, save button:** it read "Create A new save", because the no-all-caps filter skipped the one-letter A. It now reads "Create a new save".

I took the before and after pictures of screen 01 and checked the after one by eye. I didn't run the critic (it needs a score from a separate pass), so neither fix has a critic score. They're logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`.

**Found but not changed:**
- **Feedback line:** the pause box has "Please provide feedback anything that went or felt wrong." above the FEEDBACK button. That is an explaining sentence and the same job twice. It looks like his own wording from v10.41, so I left it.
- **Dead rows:** the two "coming later" server rows sit between live rows on the mode menu. They follow his v15.76 order, so I left them.
- **Rec tab:** the Settings Rec tab holds the send-to-Daniel text and the restore code, which are not settings. I haven't moved them.

I added the first two questions (feedback line, dead rows) to `questions.md`.

**ESC/TAB back-out:** reading the code, every modal closes one step. I didn't test them live.

The map is in `notes/c-30-ui-menu-map.md`. It covers how you reach each screen, the click or key counts for the common jobs, and the problems above. The Settings entry in it still has a stray "from the title?" question mark, so don't rely on it for how to reach Settings.

TASK PARTIAL: the feedback line, the dead-row order and the Settings Rec tab remain; the first two need his answer.
